overview:
This check monitors [JBoss][1] and [WildFly][2] applications.

**Minimum Agent version:** 6.11.0

[1]: https://developers.redhat.com/products/eap/overview
[2]: http://wildfly.org
setup:
### Installation

The JBoss/WildFly check is included in the [Datadog Agent][3] package so you don't need to install anything else on your JBoss/WildFly host.

### Configuration

This check has a limit of 350 metrics per instance. The number of returned metrics is indicated in [the status page][11]. You can specify the metrics you are interested in by editing the configuration below. To learn how to customize the collected metrics, see the [JMX Checks documentation][4] for more detailed instructions. If you need to monitor more metrics, contact [Datadog support][5].

<!-- xxx tabs xxx -->
<!-- xxx tab "Host" xxx -->

#### Host

To configure this check for an Agent running on a host:

##### Metric collection

1. Edit the `jboss_wildfly.d/conf.yaml` file, in the `conf.d/` folder at the root of your Agent's configuration directory to start collecting your JBoss or WildFly application server's performance data. See the [sample jboss_wildfly.d/conf.yaml][6] for all available configuration options.

    Depending on your server setup (particularly when using the `remote+http` JMX scheme), you may need to specify a custom JAR to connect to the server. Place the JAR on the same machine as your Agent, and add its path to the `custom_jar_paths` option in your `jboss_wildfly.d/conf.yaml` file.

    **Note**: The JMX url scheme is different according to your WildFly version:

   - For Wildfly 9 and older: `service:jmx:http-remoting-jmx://<HOST>:<PORT> `
   - For Wildfly 10+: `service:jmx:remote+http://<HOST>:<PORT>`

    See the [WildFly JMX subsystem configuration page][7] for more information.

2. [Restart the Agent][8].

##### Log collection

_Available for Agent versions >6.0_

1. Collecting logs is disabled by default in the Datadog Agent, enable it in your `datadog.yaml` file:

   ```yaml
   logs_enabled: true
   ```

2. Next, edit `jboss_wildfly.d/conf.yaml` by uncommenting the `logs` lines at the bottom. Update the logs `path` with the correct path to your JBoss log files.

   ```yaml
   logs:
     - type: file
       path: /opt/jboss/wildfly/standalone/log/*.log
       source: jboss_wildfly
       service: '<APPLICATION_NAME>'
   ```

3. [Restart the Agent][8].

<!-- xxz tab xxx -->
<!-- xxx tab "Containerized" xxx -->

#### Containerized

##### Metric collection

For containerized environments, see the [Autodiscovery with JMX][9] guide.

##### Log collection

_Available for Agent versions >6.0_

Collecting logs is disabled by default in the Datadog Agent. To enable it, see [Kubernetes Log Collection][10].

| Parameter      | Value                                                      |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<LOG_CONFIG>` | `{"source": "jboss_wildfly", "service": "<SERVICE_NAME>"}` |

<!-- xxz tab xxx -->
<!-- xxz tabs xxx -->

### Validation

[Run the Agent's status subcommand][11] and look for `jboss_wildfly` under the Checks section.

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_connections.active
metrics.description: number of active connections

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_connections.count
metrics.description: number of open connections

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_connections.idle
metrics.description: number of physical connections currently idle

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_connections.request_wait
metrics.description: number of requests that had to wait to obtain a physical connection

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_preparedstatementcache.hit
metrics.description: number of times that statements from the cache were used

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_preparedstatementcache.miss
metrics.description: number of times that a statement request could not be satisfied with a statement from the cache

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_preparedstatementcache.size
metrics.description: number of prepared and callable statements currently cached in the statement cache

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_xacommit.count
metrics.description: number of XAResource commit invocations

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_xarecover.count
metrics.description: number of XAResource recover invocations

metrics.name: jboss.jdbc_xarollback.count
metrics.description: number of XAResource rollback invocations

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.aborted
metrics.description: total number of transactions which have rolled back.

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.application_rollbacks
metrics.description: number of transactions rolled back by the application.

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.committed
metrics.description: number of committed transactions.

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.count
metrics.description: number of transactions (top-level and nested) created so far.

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.heuristics
metrics.description: number of transactions which have terminated with heuristic outcomes

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.inflight
metrics.description: total number of inflight (active) transactions.

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.nested
metrics.description: number of nested (sub) transactions created so far.

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.resource_rollbacks
metrics.description: number of transactions rolled back by participants.

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.system_rollbacks
metrics.description: number of transactions that were rolled back due to an internal system error.

metrics.name: jboss.transactions.timed_out
metrics.description: total number of transactions rolled back due to timeout.

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_listener.bytes_received
metrics.description: number of bytes that have been received

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_listener.bytes_sent
metrics.description: number of bytes that have been sent out

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_listener.error_count
metrics.description: number of 500 responses that have been sent

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_listener.processing_time
metrics.description: total processing time of all requests handed by this listener

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_listener.request_count
metrics.description: number of requests served

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_session.active
metrics.description: number of active sessions

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_session.alivetime_avg
metrics.description: average time (in seconds) that expired sessions had been alive

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_session.alivetime_max
metrics.description: longest time (in seconds) that an expired session had been alive

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_session.created
metrics.description: total sessions created

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_session.expired
metrics.description: number of sessions that have expired

metrics.name: jboss.undertow_session.rejected
metrics.description: number of rejected sessions

serviceChecks.name: Can Connect
serviceChecks.description: Returns `CRITICAL` if the Agent is unable to connect to and collect metrics from the monitored JBoss/WildFly instance, `WARNING` if no metrics are collected, and `OK` otherwise.
